text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(Man, what a pain... My usual toner is 
sold out everywhere.)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(That skin lotion is my favorite, too... 
Mom and Dad gave it to me...)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it just has to be that one, nothing 
else will do. Let's look a little bit 
longer.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...I really hate letting other people see 
my skin breaking out, though."
